    and the moon stopped,
    till the nation avenged itself on its enemies,
as it is written in the Book of Jashar.
    The sun stopped in the middle of the sky and delayed going down about a full day.

teaching.description:
The battles we’ve been studying in Joshua are more than just physical battles that mark moments in Israel’s history. They’re a representation of the deeply spiritual war all Christians face every day. If you’re a child of God, then you battle three powerful forces all the time—just like Joshua and the Israelites. Dr. McGee teaches us what these spiritual enemies are and how we can overcome them through the power of God’s grace. 

[THRU the BIBLE: Joshua Study 7 of 13]
teaching.name: Joshua 8:3-10:14

content: Now the five kings had fled and hidden in the cave at Makkedah.

teaching.description:

Today, discover how you can “be strong and of good courage” even when facing your worst enemies.
